The '''Mk.II Jumpmaster Class 1 hyperdrive''' was a model of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] that was produced by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]]. The [[Syliure-45 hyperdrive module/Legends|Syliure-45 hyperdrive module]] was equipped with one such drive.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
